versions.changelog:
Initial release of macd-stock-screener:

- Provides a MACD-based stock screener for A-shares, supporting both right-side (DIF upcross DEA) and left-side (DIF approaching DEA) signal detection.
- Integrates real-time sentiment analysis by collecting stock forum data (comment counts, latest posts) from East Money.
- Generates candidate lists and sentiment reports in CSV and Markdown formats per trading day.
- Command-line script supports multiple selection modes and customizable options (output path, scan-only, skip sentiment, etc.).
- Includes anti-crawling measures such as random delays and automatic captcha detection.
